title: Column | The surprising way walking can benefit your brain - The Washington Post
summary: The article discusses unexpected benefits of walking for brain health. It highlights how this simple activity can positively impact cognitive function.

title: 'It was jaw-dropping': The shocking lessons from an infamous experiment in obedience - BBC
summary: A recent analysis of obedience experiments reveals that a staggering 97.4% of participants were willing to administer painful electric shocks to others when instructed, highlighting a concerning tendency for people to follow authority figures. This finding echoes the infamous Milgram experiment, demonstrating that obedience can often override personal morals and ethics.
